transfer_path.adaptation_zh: 若迁移到视觉-AIS跨模态匹配，需要将语言指令编码器替换为AIS结构化数据编码器，将视觉观测编码器对应到船舶视觉或遥感图像编码器，并把后续的动作生成与脉冲动作分块Transformer替换为跨模态匹配或关联头；摘要未给出船舶或AIS适配实验，仅为推断。

limitations: 摘要面向机器人操作任务，没有海事情境或船舶、AIS、雷达、多传感器检测内容。
方法依赖脉冲神经网络和动作分块生成，迁移到跨模态匹配需要重构输出头与训练目标。
摘要未说明对船舶视觉或AIS数据的适配、实验或性能。
evaluation.reason_zh: 机器人操作VLA，无海事情境和船舶感知直接联系；脉冲多模态方法到跨模态匹配的迁移需大幅改造且摘要未验证，迁移证据弱。

bd3cb4aa2dbbfad21914e18bcf8daf5414922c03.title: CmIVTP: Cross-Modal Interaction-Based Vessel Trajectory Prediction for Maritime Intelligence

method_evidence.quote_en: we propose a cross-modal interaction-based vessel trajectory prediction (named CmIVTP) framework to model the intricate interactions between vessel dynamics and environmental constraints
method_evidence.interpretation_zh: 摘要提出跨模态交互式船舶轨迹预测框架CmIVTP，建模船舶动态与环境约束间的复杂交互，属于海事多模态感知与预测。

method_evidence.quote_en: we propose a cross-modal interaction transformer, which integrates AIS-derived motion features, CCTV-based environmental features, and scene representations
method_evidence.interpretation_zh: 摘要提出跨模态交互Transformer，融合AIS运动特征、CCTV环境特征与场景表征，涉及AIS与视觉的多模态融合。

method_evidence.quote_en: It leverages cross-modal attention mechanisms to simultaneously capture intra-modal semantics and inter-modal interactions, ensuring dynamically consistent and environmentally feasible predictions
method_evidence.interpretation_zh: 摘要使用跨模态注意力同时捕获模态内语义与模态间交互，用于动态一致且环境可行的预测。

method_evidence.quote_en: we construct a vessel group trajectory bank by clustering historical AIS trajectories into representative motion patterns, providing an efficient and scalable approach for candidate trajectory generation
method_evidence.interpretation_zh: 摘要通过聚类历史AIS轨迹构建船舶群轨迹库，为候选轨迹生成提供可扩展方法。

transfer_path.source_quote_en: we propose a cross-modal interaction transformer, which integrates AIS-derived motion features, CCTV-based environmental features, and scene representations
transfer_path.adaptation_zh: 若迁移到视觉-AIS关联或匹配，可将AIS运动特征编码器保留，将CCTV环境特征编码器替换为船舶视觉或遥感图像编码器，把跨模态交互Transformer的输出从轨迹预测头改为船舶身份或位置匹配头，并调整训练目标为关联损失而非轨迹回归；摘要未展示该适配。

limitations: 摘要核心是轨迹预测，不是检测、分割或跨模态关联匹配。
使用CCTV而非雷达或遥感AIS关联，迁移到视觉-AIS匹配需改变输入与输出任务。
摘要未提供跨模态匹配或关联实验。
evaluation.reason_zh: 海事AIS与CCTV跨模态融合及轨迹预测，与视觉-AIS关联和海事多模态感知相关；但直接任务是轨迹预测而非匹配，方法迁移需调整输出头，证据中等。

d85809cb767169331adb3698d6c8b653c21ee540.title: Sparse2comm: Towards Robust Cooperative 3D Object Detection

method_evidence.quote_en: Sparse Feature Encoding first encodes communication as randomly mask-sampled foreground features transmitted by collaborating agents, from which the ego vehicle reconstructs dense semantic representations
method_evidence.interpretation_zh: 摘要提出稀疏特征编码：将通信编码为随机掩码采样的前景特征，自车重建稠密语义表征，涉及稀疏到稠密重建与缺失模态恢复。

method_evidence.quote_en: This sparse-to-dense mechanism learns to infer missing object-centric content from sparse observations, enabling ultra-low-bandwidth communication and packet-loss recovery within the same representation
method_evidence.interpretation_zh: 摘要说明稀疏到稠密机制从稀疏观测推断缺失的目标中心内容，实现超低带宽通信与丢包恢复，属于缺失模态恢复方法。

method_evidence.quote_en: Latency-Aware Alignment predicts motion flow to compensate delayed messages, and Self-Calibrating Fusion estimates residual spatial offsets in a self-supervised manner before adaptive cross-agent fusion
method_evidence.interpretation_zh: 摘要提出延迟感知对齐预测运动流以补偿延迟消息，自校准融合以自监督方式估计残余空间偏移，再进行自适应跨智能体融合。

transfer_path.source_quote_en: This sparse-to-dense mechanism learns to infer missing object-centric content from sparse observations, enabling ultra-low-bandwidth communication and packet-loss recovery within the same representation
transfer_path.adaptation_zh: 若迁移到船舶多传感器检测中的缺失模态或丢包恢复，可将协同智能体替换为雷达、AIS、视觉等传感器节点，把稀疏前景特征传输改为跨传感器特征传输，训练目标改为从稀疏雷达或AIS观测重建船舶目标特征并支持检测或关联；摘要未在船舶场景验证。

limitations: 摘要面向车路协同3D检测，无海事或船舶传感器内容。
稀疏到稠密恢复和延迟对齐依赖多智能体通信设定，迁移到雷达-AIS或视觉-AIS需重新定义传感器节点与通信约束。
摘要未提供船舶检测或跨模态匹配实验。
evaluation.reason_zh: 车路协同3D检测，含稀疏特征恢复、延迟对齐与自校准融合，方法可迁移到多传感器缺失模态恢复和目标关联；但无海事直接任务验证。

b3ac09303b7ed59e7d69ec6034266361c344ee78.title: DiscoVL: Unveiling Disentangled C ross-Modal Representation Learning via Orthogonal Adversarial Regularization for V ision-Language Models

method_evidence.quote_en: we present DiscoVL, a disentangled cross-modal representation learning framework that couples orthogonal adversarial regularization with structured cross-modal alignment for vision-language models
method_evidence.interpretation_zh: 摘要提出DiscoVL解耦跨模态表征学习框架，耦合正交对抗正则与结构化跨模态对齐，用于视觉语言模型。

method_evidence.quote_en: our DiscoVL designs a multi-branch low-rank residual aligner that decomposes representations into subspaces and enables bidirectional cross-modal feedback between visual and textual streams at each layer
method_evidence.interpretation_zh: 摘要设计多分支低秩残差对齐器，将表征分解到子空间，并在每层实现视觉与文本流的双向跨模态反馈。

method_evidence.quote_en: we design an orthogonal regularization for adversarial triplet loss, which prevents centroid collapse and substantially boosts generalization
method_evidence.interpretation_zh: 摘要设计正交正则化用于对抗三元组损失，防止质心坍塌并提升泛化能力。

transfer_path.source_quote_en: our DiscoVL designs a multi-branch low-rank residual aligner that decomposes representations into subspaces and enables bidirectional cross-modal feedback between visual and textual streams at each layer
transfer_path.adaptation_zh: 若迁移到视觉-AIS跨模态匹配，可将文本流分支替换为AIS序列或结构化属性编码分支，保留多分支低秩残差对齐器与正交正则三元组损失，使视觉分支与AIS分支在子空间中对齐，训练目标改为船舶视觉与AIS目标的匹配或关联损失；摘要未在AIS或海事数据上验证。

limitations: 摘要面向视觉语言模型，无海事、船舶、AIS或雷达内容。
跨模态对齐针对图像-文本，迁移到视觉-AIS需改变模态编码器与匹配监督信号。
摘要未提供跨模态匹配或海事关联实验。
evaluation.reason_zh: 跨模态表征学习与对齐、正交对抗正则，方法可迁移至视觉-AIS跨模态匹配；但无海事背景，直接相关性中等，迁移需调整模态编码器。
